candidateSegments.teachingRole: Tires, surface and body respond together; motivation for summing forces.

observed.action: Wheels climb and drop across rocks; body tilts, vehicle continues forward.
observed.result: Contact constrains motion and changes body height/orientation.

claimLimits: No exact tire friction coefficient or force magnitude observed.
BeamNG soft-body model is not proof of our simple rigid particle equations.
Do not claim absence of slip or a constant normal force.

annotationPlan.target: Wheel-ground contact contours; track visible tire, hide behindbody/rocks, no fake sensor output.
annotationPlan.style: Progressive open contour/short leader/path with labels. No invented game measurements or internal force/skeleton data.
annotationPlan.tracking: These inspected sample frames are planning evidence, not per-frame tracking. Follow actual target; hide at occlusion/out-of-frame; clear at cut.
annotationPlan.captionClearance: Fixed bottom-centre captions and game UI protected; foreground callout should not cover the action.

candidateSegments.teachingRole: Projectile launch and backward response motivate interaction pair.

observed.before: Cannon vehicle rests on wheels facing wall.
observed.action: Cannon fires; vehicle rears up and rolls backward as wall is struck.
observed.result: Projectile/target direction and vehicle response are visibly different.

claimLimits: No equal numerical force or isolated total momentum measured.
Ground contact, gravity and rotation are present; apply equal-opposite pair in our labelled cannon/projectile model, not all forces as one pair.

annotationPlan.target: Barrel and vehicle response direction; label only observed motion, force-pair vectors in model.

candidateSegments.teachingRole: Leaving support and descending to water motivate gravity before game jump design.

observed.before: Link runs to the ledge above water.
observed.action: He jumps/dives off; descends, splashes and resurfaces.
observed.result: Loss of ground support is followed by downward movement and a new water interaction.

claimLimits: Actual dive animation, air control and buoyancy are not a pure free-fall experiment.
No exact g, initial speed or equal-fall-mass claim.

annotationPlan.target: Ledge and Link contour/downward motion guide only before splash; hide at occlusion and clear once submerged.
